content.value_statement: Skill authors need a clear reference for plugin skill structure. This skill explains the required SKILL.md file, optional support files, frontmatter fields, and writing guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains when a skill should activate for user requests.
Shows the required SKILL.md file location for a skill.
Lists optional support folders for references, examples, and scripts.
Documents supported frontmatter fields for skill metadata.
Provides guidance for writing clear trigger descriptions.
Lists best practices for focused skill content.
limitations: Does not generate complete production-ready skills by itself.
Does not validate manifests or install plugin packages.
Does not include executable helper scripts.
Does not cover advanced marketplace publishing workflows.

use_cases.title: Draft a First Skill
use_cases.description: A new skill author can use the reference structure to plan a simple SKILL.md file.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Metadata
use_cases.description: A maintainer can compare frontmatter fields against the documented examples before submitting a skill.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Concepts
use_cases.description: A documentation writer can explain how skills differ from commands and agents.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Format
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the basic structure of a Claude Code plugin skill using the example skill format.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new skill for [topic]. Include the trigger description and required SKILL.md sections.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Triggers
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill description and make the trigger conditions clearer without making them too broad: [description].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Skill Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my proposed skill file layout and frontmatter. Identify missing sections, unclear triggers, and overlap risks.

output_examples.input: Show me what files a basic skill needs.
output_examples.output: A basic skill needs one folder under skills and a SKILL.md file inside it. Extra references, examples, or scripts are optional.

output_examples.input: Help me write a skill description for database migration help.
output_examples.output: The response would suggest trigger phrases, relevant keywords, and a concise description that explains when the skill should activate.

output_examples.input: What should I check before publishing a skill?
output: Confirm the skill has a clear purpose.
Check that trigger phrases are specific.
Add examples only when they improve clarity.

best_practices: Keep each skill focused on one domain or workflow.
Write trigger descriptions with concrete user phrases and keywords.
Use supporting files only when they make complex guidance easier to maintain.
anti_patterns: Do not make a skill activate for broad or unrelated requests.
Do not omit the required name and description frontmatter fields.
Do not add helper scripts unless the workflow truly needs executable support.

faq.question: What does this skill help users create?
faq.answer: It helps users understand and draft Claude Code plugin skills with clear structure and metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed file only contains documentation examples and guidance.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does every skill need supporting files?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md is required, while references, examples, and scripts are optional.

faq.question: What makes a good skill description?
faq.answer: A good description names specific trigger phrases, keywords, and the topic area.

faq.question: Is this a complete marketplace publishing guide?
faq.answer: No. It is a format reference, not a full publishing or validation workflow.
